Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing ONE issue in the Email OS Vue/Tauri client (repo = your worktree). Read first: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md (colours: surface, surface-raised #33312e, focus-fill #474644, rail/dividers; "Dusk Lavender" focus bar rules; anti-reference: "oversized rounded panels", "card stacks" — keep any card-ness flat and subtle), src/components/ReaderView.vue, src/assets/style.css (.message, .message.message-active, tokens at :root).

## Shared rules (all reader-review tasks)
- Context: we compared our conversation reader against a Superhuman screenshot. In Superhuman the active (expanded) message is a slightly raised flat panel (surface just lighter than the page) with a 3px lavender bar on its left edge, bold sender, and — on the right of the header next to the date — small quiet reply and forward icon buttons. Ours: the active message uses the heavy `focus-fill` (#474644) background + inset 3px bar, and has no per-message actions.
- Stay on-brand per PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md: terse, honest-state, keyboard-first, no AI features. Message content text-interpolated only. Reply preparation must keep targeting the explicitly displayed LATEST message (see file header comment) — NOT the focused message; so don't add a per-message reply that targets the focused message. Therefore: only render a quiet reply icon on the card when that message IS the latest message (same condition/behaviour as the existing Prepare reply, emitting the same event); do NOT add forward (not a feature here).
- Keep every existing `data-test` attribute and aria-label; update tests in tests/ and src that your change legitimately affects. Do NOT edit DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md — put design-doc notes in your final report.
- Other agents are changing the same files in parallel on separate branches (toolbar→header (which also keeps/moves the main Prepare reply control), collapsed snippets, body type/measure, Details/focus-ring dedupe, star status line, recent-mail filter). Keep your diff MINIMAL and localized (.message-active styles + a tiny template addition); no reformatting. Because the header-icons agent may also touch the reply control, keep your reply icon's markup self-contained and gated on the same `replyBlockedReason`/browsingOnly/readOnly conditions the existing Prepare reply uses.
- Setup: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Verify with `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` (full suite; report honestly incl. pre-existing failures).
- Preview: `pnpm dev --port <PORT> --strictPort` (in-memory fixture workspace). Use mcp__t3-code__preview_* tools (load via ToolSearch), resize 1280x800, press Enter on the focused first row to open "Fixture thread 1: weekly status". Stop dev server and close preview tab when done.
- Evidence: save PNGs under the evidence dir below (mkdir -p). BEFORE (base commit) and AFTER at 1280x800 via preview_snapshot save=true (copy screenshotPath to named files). If blurry, retry and report computed colours/contrast.
- Commit on your worktree's branch (no push, no PR). End the commit message with: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Final report (brief): branch + head SHA, files changed, what you did, tests run/results, evidence absolute paths, DESIGN.md notes, anything you couldn't do.

## Your issue: P3 – Active message as a raised card
- Change `.message.message-active` from `--focus-fill` to the `--surface-raised` token (#33312e) (verify the token exists in style.css; add a CSS variable only if missing), keep the 3px lavender inset bar and bold primary-colour sender. Square or ≤4px radius (DESIGN scale), no shadow, no border; ensure text contrast of secondary text on the raised surface stays ≥ the existing ratio (measure and report).
- Add a quiet reply icon button (16px glyph, icon-muted → text-primary on hover/focus, 24px hit area, title "Reply (R)"-style via the existing actionLabel helper if present, accessible name "Prepare reply") at the right end of the active message header, only on the latest message, same enabled/disabled/blocked conditions as Prepare reply, same emit. The button must not nest inside the message-toggle button (invalid HTML) — place as a sibling in a header row wrapper, keeping the toggle's full-width click target; make sure this doesn't alter the DOM contract tests rely on (`message-toggle-<id>`).
- The reply icon should be visible on the active latest message only (not on hover-only, to stay keyboard-discoverable).
- Evidence dir: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p3-active-card . PORT: 5206. Required: before/after at 1280x800 with the latest message active, after with an earlier message active (no reply icon), after with the reply icon focused, and contrast numbers.
